column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 2 - Summer Comiket Arc
Ku-Kukuku... Kuroneko?
Wrong.
Fufu... My name is Yamineko. My soul eroded, I have reincarnated as a dark angel.
Kuroneko, right?
I-I said I'm not.
What's she on about?
She's even more of an oddball than usual.
I-I see... So you're in a circle as well, huh.
Yes... I am. All by myself.
She seems to be in a really bad mood for some reason.
Hmph. Well, it's like always. It was the same during Winter Comiket. After all, I live in a different world than you lowly humans.
H-Hey now, why do you look so dejected?
...I don't.
...What about you? Do you really have time to be here, considering you should be busy preparing for your exams?
It's no big deal. It's fine, really. In fact, I'm ahead of schedule.
Wha-
Haha, thanks for worrying about me though.
W-What... T-Then why... did I... have to...
Something wrong?
It's nothing!
Woah?!
W-What's wrong with her, yelling like that all of a sudden?
...You buffoon.
What's that?
None of your business. Just talking to myself.
Hmph. Well? Why are you here? Did you come to laugh at me because I haven't sold a single volume?
Of course not.
S-She hasn't sold a single one?
I see. You've come to flaunt your cute girlfriend.
However, it's all in vain. Regardless who you're going out with, I will not feel a thing, for I have given my heart to the darkness.
T-That's a pretty severe persecution complex.
Kuroneko, you're... You're totally sulking.
I see. So that's how it was. Fufu... I knew it. You've been deceiving me all along.
Fufufu... But it's meaningless to continue toying with my heart. I will no longer feel a thing, for I have given my heart to the darkness.
T-That's a pretty severe persecution complex.
Kuroneko, you're... You're totally sulking.
O-Onii-san... Is she alright? She seems dangerous.
Says you?!
I-It's alright. Leave it to me.
H-Hey... Kuroneko? Calm down, it's just a misunderstanding.
A misunderstanding? ...What exactly is this misunderstanding then?
Err, let me introduce you two first.
This is Aragaki Ayase. She's Kirino's classmate and best friend.
That woman's... best friend?
H-Hello...
Now that you mention it... She does look familiar.
Y-Yes. We met briefly at last year's Summer Comiket.
...Ah, that time.
Phew... Seems like that misunderstanding has been cleared up.
I'm shocked. To think you'd lay your hands on your sister's best friend; you're the worst.
I'm telling you that's not it! Isn't that right, Ayase?
...Yes.
Hmm, really now? I doubt it.
What's wrong, Kuroneko? You're being even more spiteful than usual today.
Hmph. I've told you already.
Right now... I'm the angel of vengeance, Yamineko.
L-Laying my hands on... W-What are you saying?
So you won't deny it.
O-Onii-san!
Sorry, for a moment there I felt like showing off.
G-Geez! U-Um... W-Well, it's not like that.
Fu... Fufufu... I-I see. So this flood of negative thoughts is what's behind that feeling of "go explode, you normals".
H-Hey, Kuroneko, don't misunderstand. You're really behaving strangely today.
Hmph. I've told you already.
Right now... I'm the angel of vengeance, Yamineko.
